The highlight of this match for him was the dramatic stoppage-time goal by Rodrygo, which contributed to Real Madrid's stunning comeback victory. During this game, Real Madrid was trailing 3-0 but managed to score two goals in the last minutes of the match, showcasing their resilience and ability to perform under pressure. This event is remembered as a testament to Madrid's never-say-die attitude and the club's capacity for thrilling turns of events during football matches.
